items.statement: For these actual source nodes and integral coefficients, sum_j |b_j| <= h*Lambda. The finite compact supremum and every needed interval integrability are derived from polynomial continuity. No b_j>=0 or supplied coefficient envelope is assumed.
assumptions: J is a natural number>=2 and h is a positive real. Fin J uses indices i=0,...,J-1 corresponding to source j=i+1.

t_i=h/2[1-cos(i*pi/(J-1))]; ell_j is the real Mathlib Lagrange cardinal polynomial at those nodes; Lambda is the actual supremum of sum_j|ell_j(s)| on the compact interval[0,h]; b_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s) ds using real Lebesgue measure.

bindings.boundary: Derived absolute-integral prerequisite for Appendix D1/D2 using the actual B1 coefficients. This does not prove individual Clenshaw-Curtis weight nonnegativity, logarithmic Lambda, complete B1, interpolation remainder B2 or either main theorem.
